description: Root DISTINCT and ORDER BY with boolean and string directions.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS n ORDER BY p.age DESC, n ASC

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS n ORDER BY p.age DESC, n ASC $$) AS (n agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS n ORDER BY p.age DESC, n ASC

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name AS n)) ORDER BY age DESC, n ASC

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name AS n)) ORDER BY age DESC, n ASC
